# What does each retirement age pay a federal employee?

> Free FERS retirement calculator for federal employees: your pension, the Special Retirement Supplement and TSP income at every retirement age, MRA+10 reduction, the 1.1% multiplier at 62, sick leave credit and survivor cost. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
